name: assimilation/harness/openclaw
description: Orchestrate babysitter SDK integration into OpenClaw Gateway. OpenClaw is a Node.js daemon for personal AI that routes messages from multiple channels (WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack) through isolated agent sessions backed by SQLite persistence. Uses npm plugin packages with openclaw field in package.json, lifecycle hooks, and daemon-safe reentry via agent_end or session resume callbacks.
